description: This PHP script manages the removal of dashboard pages for the current user in the SuiteCRM project, specifically within the 'Home' module. It displays a confirmation form if multiple pages exist and removes a specified page upon confirmation, then redirects to the main dashboard view.

classes.name: SugarApplication
classes.description: Main application class for SuiteCRM handling web requests and redirection.

methods.description: Retrieves user preferences such as dashboard pages.
